To: @renee.whitlock
Replying to: s01
Cc: none
Subject: Football rundown for Monday admin meeting — draft

Renee, here's our rundown for the admin meeting. Been a good week for these kids and a whole lot of folks helping them.

We beat Brookhollow 31-14 Friday and locked up second in the region. Deshawn Pettaway had 3 sacks and 7 tackles. The kids voted him defensive player of the week right there in the locker room before the coaches even met. That says something about how his teammates saw him play. Defense held Brookhollow to 46 yards rushing in the second half.

Tavion Hurst finished with 188 yards rushing and 2 touchdowns. His long touchdown in the third quarter was a big one, but I want to give that offensive line their due. They were pushing folks 5 yards back that whole drive. Best I've seen them block all year.

We've got a HOME playoff game: Clanton Valley, Friday, November 13, 7 p.m. at Ridge Field. Please make sure Dr. Pruitt knows, and let him know we'd love to have folks come out and support these boys. Presale tickets start Tuesday. Gate crew and chain crew need to be confirmed by Wednesday. Boosters also need 6 more concession volunteers; signup sheet goes out today.

Academically, all 52 players are eligible after the nine-week grade check. Nobody on the list. Tonya Greer deserves the credit for that, not me. Her Tuesday and Thursday study hall is making a difference, and she's keeping it going through the playoffs.

The Boston butt sale finished at 208 sold and $6,240 raised, beating the $4,500 goal by $1,740. That money is going toward new sideline headsets. Big thanks to Carla, the boosters, and Hargrove's Meat Market for doing the smoking at cost.

If we win and go on the road, I'll get the bus request information to you with that five-day transportation deadline in mind.
